description.value: The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel now trades as Crowne Plaza Manhattan Times Square - formerly The Manhattan at Times Square, so look for the IHG name. The serious watch-outs: There was constant, loud renovation noise from upstairs next door, and one guest reports The room's hygiene was terrible, so inspect the room at check-in.

review1: Location is the main reason guests choose this hotel, with reviews describing it as right in the middle of Times Square and the theater district.
review2: Guests frame it as a good pick when booked at a deal price, with value depending heavily on the rate secured for the dates.
review3: Noise from renovation work next door is a recurring complaint in the set, so light sleepers should ask about construction before arrival.
review4: Some guests report disappointing room hygiene, which is the most serious watch-out and worth checking immediately at check-in. It comes up often enough to plan around.
